scope: Concrete repairs to exact assigned 202 subjects, 134 relationships and 336 tasks; additional no-successor historical relationships were inspected independently.
prior_source_review: All owned pages 1–158 and every assigned draft record were inspected in finalized earlier phases; repair phase reuses those judgments, rechecks changed claims and rereads uncertain eligible pages.
additional_historical_review: All 1,038 exact old records were matched to frozen old books. Endpoint identities, source clue types, descriptions and page scopes were inspected; prior endpoint/source review was reused. Twenty-seven later-page requirements are referrals rather than claimed fulfilled. Author dispositions were not used to choose verdicts.
read_boundary: Only authorized input packets and their files, exact assignment, exact lead scope file, installed methodology/runtime/docs, and own outputs/work files. No candidate, root validation/docs, sibling review files, app/task history or unrelated files.
write_boundary: Public repair artifacts only in this repairs directory; helper scripts and source work only in own restricted repairs work directory.
preservation: No canonical draft/state/final/review or finalized shard artifact edited.
approval: No whole-book approval, freeze or candidate evaluation implied.
